acceptance: The Summary and final audit report enumerate WI-01 through WI-17 with status, Outcome/handoff evidence, blocking history, retained risks, and explicit performance/Outcome limitations.

All release readiness, source-bound evidence, distribution, state-consistency, security, lockfile, and strict full-quality checks pass on the exact candidate base, or a provider-bound failure is recorded and publication is blocked.
The published release tag, source commit, metadata commit, release assets, and Quick Install validation are mutually consistent; no claim of publication is made without provider evidence.

All audited stale local/remote Work Item branches and linked worktrees are removed only after identity and cleanliness checks; the final closure audit reports no residue outside explicitly retained user worktrees.

The archived Outcome and Human Benefit Report use the conversation locale, follow the required Human Summary structure, bind factual fields to evidenceRefs, and mark unsupported benefits as inference.
The Work Item is merged and closed through the canonical lifecycle, with clean local and remote branch state verified after closure.
guidelines: Every factual report claim must cite evidenceRefs; unsupported benefit language is inference only.
Do not use self-praise or unquantified performance/quality claims.
Historical archive files are immutable and may only be read and referenced.
Release publication is fail-closed on missing, stale, mismatched, or provider-unverified evidence.
The human handoff must be direct, clear, and emitted in the conversation language (English for this Work Item).

intent.problem: The remediation sequence needs one final exact-source publication and a repository audit that makes historical Outcome gaps, performance evidence limits, and branch/worktree residue explicit without rewriting immutable history.
constraints: Use the latest synchronized origin/main and the repository release workflow; fail closed on missing or mismatched provider evidence.
Do not rewrite historical archive files, move immutable tags, or claim performance or Outcome delivery beyond recorded evidence.
Delete only branches and worktrees whose identity and cleanliness are recorded by this Work Item; preserve unrelated user work.
intent.rationale: A final release and cleanup can be trusted only when each prior Work Item, the exact release identity, and the final repository state are independently auditable.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: WI-01 through WI-17 archives, Outcomes, human handoffs, retained warnings, and performance claims are enumerated without rewriting history.
scenarioCoverage.expectedResult: Every archived WI has a recorded status and evidence-backed gap or pass classification.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Audit archive index and Outcome JSON, then record counts and evidenceRefs in the Summary and final audit report.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Local branches, remote branches, linked worktrees, and open/merged PR identities are reconciled before deletion.
scenarioCoverage.expectedResult: Only the active WI-18 branch/worktree remains until canonical closure; no stale remote branch remains after closure.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Capture git branch/worktree/remote/PR evidence, delete only audited residue, and repeat the audit after close.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Candidate v0.5.61 is published only when sourceCommit, tagTarget, metadataCommit, CI evidence, and release assets match.
scenarioCoverage.expectedResult: The release workflow reports the exact merged main SHA and tagged Quick Install evidence, or publication remains blocked with a documented reason.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run local release readiness, dispatch the exact-source workflow if eligible, and validate release-state/distribution evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The final Outcome is delivered to the human in English with completed, passed, retained, risks, unknowns, decisions, and next action fields.
scenarioCoverage.expectedResult: Direct handoff is clear, evidenceRefs are present for factual claims, and unsupported benefits are marked inference.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run strict ai-finish with REPORT_LANGUAGE=en and inspect archived Outcome JSON/Markdown and task_report pair.
